evidence.statement: Retrospective parameter association is significant in C. elegans but not in the aggregate excluding C. elegans; fresh validation must therefore target a separate animal rather than claim universality.
A C. elegans-trained parameter-context model and independent Drosophila validation tests are frozen before GCF_000001215.4 acquisition.
Arabidopsis and Panel-3 topology addenda are frozen to distinguish animal-specific parameterization from broader eukaryotic architecture and to propagate absolute-slot controls prospectively.
